description: This Java class 'CsvDatatableReportExportServiceImpl' implements the 'DatatableReportExportService' interface to enable exporting report data in CSV format. It uses a reporting service to retrieve report data as CSV and prepares an HTTP response with appropriate headers for file download.

classes.name: CsvDatatableReportExportServiceImpl
classes.description: A Spring service class that provides CSV export functionality for data table reports, utilizing a reporting service.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Generates a CSV report as an HTTP Response, setting content type and headers for attachment download.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Indicates whether this export service supports the specified export target type (CSV).
